data.name: Kishansinh
data.gender_notes: Kishansinh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kishansinh is a compound name, consisting of 'Kishan' and 'Sinh'. 'Kishan' means 'God of Fortune' and 'Sinh' means 'Lion'. Therefore, Kishansinh can be interpreted as 'God of Fortune, who is as powerful as a lion'. The name Kishansinh carries the meaning “God of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Kishansinh usually hope their child will grow to embody god of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Kishansinh is a powerful name, associated with the deity of wealth and prosperity. It is believed to bring good fortune, courage, and strength to the bearer. It is also considered a warrior name, symbolizing bravery and loyalty.
data.etymology: Kishansinh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kishansinh total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

'Kishan' is a name of the Hindu deity Vishnu, who is often depicted as the god of abundance, prosperity, and protector of the earth. 'Singh', on the other hand, is a Sanskrit word for 'lion', which is a symbol of courage, strength, and royalty in Hinduism. Together, 'Kishansinh' can be interpreted as 'The Lion of God of Abundance' or 'The Protector of Prosperity'.
